items.q: How is each note written and reviewed?
items.a: A named engineer writes each note from a real question; a named reviewer checks it before publication. Each claim names standard, clause and edition. [Named author and reviewer, by topic group]

items.q: Can we cite a note in our validation documents?
items.a: No: cite the standard, not the note. A note is our reading of the clause; your quality unit decides how it applies to your site.

items.q: What happens when a standard changes?
items.a: We review and update the note and its review date. If the answer changes, the note says what and when. Errors get a dated correction line.
